info.title: SmartGN - Alerting & Notifications
info.description: Telemetry-based alert rules, alert acknowledgment and resolution, notification preferences and delivery tracking. Stores alerts and delivery history in PostgreSQL. Local Docker Compose uses a simulated notification provider.
